EXPECTED_STATUS_CAVEAT: Tier A remains conditional on common support, authoritative well/screen/layer identity, QA, and sufficient locations reserved for untouched spatial validation.
PUBLIC_DATA_ONLY_INTERPRETATION: Public data support an aggregate water-budget benchmark and useful state/propagation audits, but not a well/facility dynamic benchmark because per-well pumping and complete geocoded recharge/injection forcing are missing.

gate_results.evidence: 552 public DWR wells have usable head observations; threshold is 50.
gate_results.name: STATE

gate_results.evidence: Best annual intersection: 179 wells in every year of a 5-year window and 146 in every year of a 10-year window. Longest consecutive monthly run with at least 50 observed wells is 86 months (1991-10 to 1998-11); individual cadence remains heterogeneous.
gate_results.name: TEMPORAL

gate_results.evidence: OCWD documents monthly large-well WRMS reporting covering about 97% of extraction, but geocoded per-well raw pumping is not public in this package.
gate_results.name: PUMPING

gate_results.evidence: Named-facility 2009-10 recharge and 2023 combined MBI monthly injection are reproducibly extractable, but complete geocoded monthly facility/well forcing is not public.
gate_results.name: RECHARGE

gate_results.evidence: DWR perforations cover 121 basin stations and MBI screens/layers are authoritative for that project; basinwide authoritative aquifer/model-layer mapping is missing.
gate_results.name: VERTICAL

gate_results.evidence: The audit distinguishes OBSERVED, REPORTED_MEASURED, DERIVED_FROM_MEASUREMENTS, ESTIMATED, MODELED, and REFERENCE_MODEL quantities.
gate_results.name: PROVENANCE

gate_results.evidence: Public heads cannot yet be aligned with absent per-well WRMS pumping and complete facility/well recharge histories.
gate_results.name: COMMON SUPPORT

gate_results.evidence: Public state locations are counted without performance-based selection; final held-out-well design remains conditional on cadence, vertical identity, and forcing overlap.
gate_results.name: SPATIAL VALIDATION

gate_results.evidence: Registry contains 35 published tracer experiment-well records and 5 MBI operational-start events; independence from future model fitting is explicit.
gate_results.name: INDEPENDENT PROPAGATION VALIDATION

gate_results.evidence: Public DWR/USGS data are machine-readable and report extracts are page-traceable, but required WRMS pumping/recharge tables are not public.
gate_results.name: REPRODUCIBILITY
